number_of_accused.reason: Three accused are named in the judgment.

previous_criminal_record.reason: No prior criminal record is mentioned.

victim_gender.reason: No individual victim is identified in the judgment.

victim_age.reason: No victim is identified, so no age is stated.

offence_category.quote: Prevention of Corruption Act, 1988- ss.13(2) and 13(1)(d)
offence_category.reason: Corruption offences under the Prevention of Corruption Act are the charged category.

statutory_provisions.quote: Sections 13(2) and 13(1) (d) of Prevention of Corruption Act read with Section 120B of the Indian Penal Code, 1960
statutory_provisions.reason: Provisions match the charges stated in the judgment.

weapon.reason: No weapon is mentioned anywhere in the judgment.

evidence_type.quote: only charge-sheet along with the accompanying material is to be considered
evidence_type.reason: Judgment never characterises evidence as circumstantial; it only refers to charge-sheet material.

confession.reason: Judgment is silent on confession; asserting 'None' goes beyond the text.

aggravating_circumstances.quote: Not applicable to sentencing; no aggravating factors discussed
aggravating_circumstances.reason: No aggravating circumstances are identified in the judgment.

mitigating_circumstances.quote: Not applicable to sentencing; no mitigating factors discussed
mitigating_circumstances.reason: No mitigating circumstances are identified in the judgment.

trial_court_outcome.quote: the First Additional Sessions Judge/ Special Judge, Indore, after perusing the charge-sheet ... ordered framing of charges against the three accused
trial_court_outcome.reason: Trial court ordered framing of charges against the three accused.

high_court_outcome.quote: The High Court allowed the Revision Petitions and set aside the order of framing charges
high_court_outcome.reason: High Court set aside the framing of charges order.

final_outcome.correct_value: Order framing charges restored; no conviction; case sent back for trial
final_outcome.quote: these criminal appeals are allowed, the order passed by the High Court is set aside and the order of the Addi. Sessions Judge framing charges is restored
final_outcome.reason: No conviction occurred; the Supreme Court only restored framing of charges for trial.

offence_finally_established.correct_value: Not stated (only a prima facie case found for framing charges)
offence_finally_established.quote: we are of the view that there exists sufficient material to make out a prima facie case against the accused
offence_finally_established.reason: Only prima facie sufficiency at pre-trial stage; no offence was finally established.

imprisonment_type.reason: No sentence of imprisonment is imposed or discussed.

fine_rs.reason: No fine is stated; the Rs.5,49,000 figure relates to alleged tax evasion, not a fine.

neutral_facts.correct_value: The accused, including Rakesh Mishra, were alleged to have granted building and completion certificates to a hotel and club without required approvals. The original permission was granted to the applicant; a revised plan was later sanctioned with major changes in built-up area. The revision was granted without committee approval, and honorary membership of the club was accepted. The prosecution alleged illegal gratification and misuse of authority.
neutral_facts.quote: The High Court set aside the order of framing charges, but the Supreme Court restored the order, finding sufficient material
neutral_facts.reason: Facts are largely accurate, but the final sentence reveals the Supreme Court outcome, which is prohibited.

offence_severity.reason: Judgment does not state any punishment range for the offences.

attempt_completion.quote: the completion certificate which was granted on 19.01.1995
attempt_completion.reason: The alleged acts of granting revision and certificates were completed.

physical_harm.reason: No physical harm is mentioned in the judgment.

number_of_offences.correct_value: Offences charged under s.13(2) and s.13(1)(d) PCA and s.120B IPC; no final adjudication of these
number_of_offences.quote: The offences charged against the accused are the offences under Section 13(2) and Section 13(1)(d) of the Prevention of Corruption Act and Section 120B
number_of_offences.reason: Charged provisions are right, but 'all finally upheld' is wrong; only charge framing was upheld.

financial_property_loss.correct_value: Alleged property tax evasion of Rs.5,49,000, later paid by the Hotel per High Court; alleged illegal gains to Sajid Dhanani
financial_property_loss.quote: the alleged amount of Rs.5,49,000 was paid by Hotel Sayaji when it was demanded by the department
financial_property_loss.reason: Judgment discusses alleged property tax evasion of Rs.5,49,000, so 'Not applicable' is contradicted.

premeditation_planning.quote: these three accused hatched a criminal conspiracy
premeditation_planning.reason: Conspiracy is alleged, but no specific premeditation details are discussed; 'Not stated' is reasonable.

motive.correct_value: Illegal gratification: free lifetime honorary membership of the Sayaji Club for Jadon and family
motive.quote: as illegal gratification, Sayaji Hotel provided free lifetime honorary membership to G.S. Jadon and his family members
motive.reason: The judgment identifies illegal gratification as the alleged motive.

key_evidence_accepted.correct_value: At the pre-trial stage, the revised plan's major changes, completion certificate granted 7 days after revision, and acceptance of honorary membership were held sufficient for a prima facie case
key_evidence_accepted.quote: there exists sufficient material to make out a prima facie case against the accused
key_evidence_accepted.reason: Right facts, but they were treated as prima facie material, not accepted as proven evidence.

witness_credibility.reason: No witnesses are discussed or assessed in the judgment; the value invents an assessment.

trial_duration.quote: High Court ... dated 18.05.2007; Criminal Appeal ... MARCH 23, 2015
trial_duration.reason: HC and SC dates match; trial and offence dates are not stated.

legal_representation.quote: Arvind Varma, Deepika Shari, C. D. Singh for the Appellant ... Sumit kumar Sharma, Niraj Sharma, Brajesh Kumar for the Respondent

investigation_status.correct_value: FIR lodged 18-01-1998; charge-sheet filed; trial not yet concluded (court directed trial court to conduct trial expeditiously)
investigation_status.quote: the Trial Court to conduct the trial in the most expeditious manner
investigation_status.reason: Judgment shows trial has not concluded; 'trial completed' is contradicted.

procedural_irregularity.quote: the accused not only granted the revision without approval of any committee
procedural_irregularity.reason: No procedural irregularity in court proceedings is noted; the committee lapse is substantive conduct.

appeal_history.quote: these criminal appeals are allowed, the order passed by the High Court is set aside
appeal_history.reason: Sequence of trial court, High Court and Supreme Court orders matches the judgment.

prosecution_argument.correct_value: The State argued the High Court traversed beyond the permissible limit in deciding legality of framing charges at the pre-trial stage
prosecution_argument.quote: the High Court traversed beyond the permissible limit while deciding the legality of order framing charges, being a pre-trial stage
prosecution_argument.reason: Core argument is right, but the 'only charge-sheet' principle was the Court's statement, not the State's argument.

defence_argument.quote: G.S. Jadon was in the office of Building Officer from 31.10.1994 to 16.10.1996. He cannot be held liable for any act/omission done prior to or after this period
defence_argument.reason: Defence arguments on tenure and s.482 inherent jurisdiction are accurately stated.

legal_principle_applied.quote: only charge-sheet along with the accompanying material is to be considered at the stage of framing of charges
legal_principle_applied.reason: Principle of prima facie assessment at framing of charges is stated accurately.

precedent_relied_upon.quote: Various authorities have been cited before us
precedent_relied_upon.reason: Authorities were referred to generally but none are named; 'Not stated' is accurate.

sentencing_rationale.reason: No sentencing is imposed, so no sentencing rationale exists.

judicial_mitigating_factors.reason: No mitigating factors are considered by the Court.

judicial_aggravating_factors.reason: No aggravating factors are considered by the Court.

other_sentence_order.correct_value: Direction to the Trial Court to conduct the trial in the most expeditious manner
other_sentence_order.quote: we request the Trial Court to conduct the trial in the most expeditious manner
other_sentence_order.reason: Value says 'None', but the Court directed expeditious trial.
